voice.title: Voice settings
voice.intro: These are the settings that decide how the device listens and speaks: the wake word, how it tells speech from silence, the plugins that turn speech into text and text into speech, the order it tries to understand a command, and the language. Every change is written into your own layer of mycroft.conf, the same file the Settings page's Advanced tab edits — this page just gives each setting a plain picker.
voice.restart: The wake word, the speech-to-text engine and the silence detector apply as soon as you save. The order the device tries to understand a command needs a restart, and so does changing the voice. If something does not change, restart the OVOS services.
voice.ww.title: Wake word
voice.ww.hint: The name the device listens for before it pays attention to you. Only wake words already set up in the hotwords section can be chosen here.
voice.ww.label: Wake word
voice.ww.empty: No wake words are set up on this device yet. Add one in the Advanced tab of Settings, or install a wake-word plugin on the Plugins page.
voice.vad.title: Listening (voice activity)
voice.vad.hint: The plugin that decides where your speech starts and stops, once the wake word has fired.
voice.vad.label: Voice activity plugin
voice.vad.empty: No voice-activity plugins are installed. Install one on the Plugins page; the current value is kept until you change it.
voice.stt.title: Speech to text
voice.stt.hint: The plugin that turns what you say into text. A fallback is tried only when the primary one fails.
voice.stt.empty: No speech-to-text plugins are installed. Install one on the Plugins page.
voice.tts.title: Text to speech
voice.tts.hint: The plugin that speaks the device's replies. A fallback is tried only when the primary one fails.
voice.tts.empty: No text-to-speech plugins are installed. Install one on the Plugins page.
voice.pipeline.title: Pipeline order
voice.pipeline.hint: When you speak, the device tries each of these in order and stops at the first one that understands you. Move an entry up to have it tried sooner.
voice.transformers.title: Transformers
voice.transformers.hint: Utterance transformers clean up or change what you said before the device tries to understand it. Metadata transformers add extra information to a request before it is handled. Turn one on or off below.
voice.lang.title: Language
voice.lang.hint: The language the device speaks and listens in, for example en-us or pt-pt. Extra languages can be added below; the device also tries to understand those, alongside the main one.

transformers.intro: Transformers are small plugins that change a request as it moves through the device. Each stage below is its own chain. Turn a plugin on or off, set the order the device runs them in, and edit a plugin's own settings. Every change is saved to the configuration file.
transformers.needsToken: These settings change how the device understands and answers you, so this page needs an access token, like the other device pages.
transformers.utterance.title: Utterance transformers
transformers.utterance.desc: Change or clean up what you said before the device works out what you mean.
transformers.metadata.title: Metadata transformers
transformers.metadata.desc: Add extra information to a request before a skill handles it.
transformers.intent.title: Intent transformers
transformers.intent.desc: Change a matched intent before the skill runs.
transformers.audio.title: Audio transformers
transformers.audio.desc: Act on the captured audio, for example to detect a sound or a language.
transformers.dialog.title: Dialog transformers
transformers.dialog.desc: Change a reply's text before the device speaks it.
transformers.tts.title: Speech transformers
transformers.tts.desc: Change the synthesized audio after text-to-speech, for example to tune the voice.
transformers.emptyChain: No plugins configured in this chain.
transformers.notObject: Settings must be a JSON object.
transformers.bidi.title: Bidirectional translation
transformers.bidi.desc: Talk to the device in another language and hear the answer back in the same language. This turns on two translation plugins together: one translates your words into the device's own language, the other translates the reply back.
transformers.bidi.missing: The ovos-bidirectional-translation-plugin is not installed. Install it on the Plugins page first.
transformers.bidi.langs: Languages to translate to and from, comma separated (for example pt-pt, es-es)
transformers.bidi.verify: Trust the detected language over the set one
transformers.bidi.ignoreInvalid: Ignore a detected language that is not recognised
transformers.sox.title: Voice tuning
transformers.sox.desc: Change how the spoken voice sounds by applying sound effects to it: pitch, speed, reverb and tone. This uses the SoX speech transformer.
transformers.sox.missing: The ovos-tts-transformer-sox-plugin is not installed. Install it on the Plugins page first.
